description: Use when an agent, marketplace, provider, or investor needs to separate observable Base USDC settlement evidence from unsupported independent-demand claims. Detects direct self-payments, classifies disclosed related-party and unattributed receipts, measures payer concentration, and does not call unknown wallets customers. Agent payment guidance: run free can-pay and readiness checks first; pay only when policy allows base 0x833589fCD6eDb6E08f4c7C32D4f71b54bdA02913 and 0.02 USDC is inside the agent budget. [PAID: 0.02 USDC via x402 on Base. Two-step flow: call without payment to receive MCP PaymentRequired, then retry with params._meta['x402/payment'] containing the signed PaymentPayload. The legacy _x402_payment base64 argument is also supported. Sign only after explicit budget and policy approval.]

_x402_payment.description: base64 x402 PaymentPayload (USDC on Base); obtain the requirements by calling this tool without it first.

expected_recipient.description: Optional recipient wallet address expected for these settlement receipts.

related_addresses.description: Disclosed provider-controlled or related wallet addresses; omission does not establish independence.

tx_hashes.description: One to twenty public Base settlement transaction hashes to classify.

name: ontario_x402-demand-authenticity
title: x402 Demand Authenticity Report

x402.not_for: Do not buy to prove that an unattributed wallet is an independent customer; the report refuses that inference.
x402.purchase_reason: Obtain a bounded batch classification, payer-concentration summary, explicit claim boundary, and canonical evidence digest.
x402.selection_rule: Use the free single-receipt checker first; pay only when one task needs a machine-readable batch report for up to 20 receipts.
